feeds.title: Add To Wantlist » Jangle Pop
feeds.description: Follow the blog and learn more about upcoming releases, tips, albums, articles, and more. The Add to Want List blog is here to help you fight off that musical paralysis. It is run by two brothers on a constant journey to uncover past and future gems in an ever-expanding musical landscape. They share what they dig up and like because they care, about the music, and the artists.

feeds.title: mp3hugger » Jangle Pop
feeds.description: Tap into the blog and learn more about mixtapes, records, articles, interviews, and more. mp3hugger is an indie music blog based off the Irish coast towards Iceland. It started in September 2005 to introduce new music to people who may not otherwise get to hear it.

feeds.title: Obscure Sound » Jangle-Pop/Rock
feeds.description: Visit the blog and learn more about genres, albums, playlists, interviews, articles, and more. Obscure Sound is an indie music site that Mike Mineo formed in February 2006 out of a love for finding new and emerging quality music. He wrote for Pop Matters and Stylus Magazine a few years before forming OS. It aims to feature quality music, preferably from artists you've never heard of before. They provide streaming audio in addition to accompanying write-ups.

feeds.title: ECLECTIC MUSIC LOVER » Jangle Pop
feeds.description: Wade through the Eclectic Music Lover blog and learn more about favorite song lists, reviews, featured indie artists, music commentary, and more. The eclectic Music Lover blog is owned and operated by Jeff, a now old man based in Palm Springs, California, who's just a wannabe DJ - of his radio station.
